description.value:
You draw upon your knowledge of the Banshee, reshaping your vocal cords into a monstrous approximation of its spectral wail. You unleash a bone-chilling keening cry that pierces the mind of all who hear it. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude saving throw, taking 8d8 sonic damage on a failure. A creature that is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Deafened]{Deafened} is immune to this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 4} for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Unconscious]{Unconscious} for 1 minute. The creature can attempt a DC 15 flat check at the end of each of its turns to recover from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Unconscious]{Unconscious} condition.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d8.
